🚀 Team Enablement

Microsoft Copilot Rollout

A three-phase approach to Copilot adoption: from quick start basics to in-app productivity, with hands-on practice at every step.

The Rollout Strategy

This isn't about watching demos. It's about building muscle memory through real work. The rollout moves through three phases, each unlocking new capabilities while reinforcing the last.

PHASE 1

Copilot Chat

Foundation skills. Everyone starts here. Browser-based, no special provisioning needed.

Week 1-2
PHASE 2

Copilot in M365

In-app integration. Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Teams, Outlook. Requires license provisioning.

Week 3-6
PHASE 3

Advanced Workflows

Agents, automation, custom GPTs. Transform how work gets done.

Week 7+
Current Status: Phase 1 is available NOW. Phase 2 (Copilot in-app) is pending approval — this rollout prepares the team so we're ready the moment licenses are provisioned.

Phase 1: Copilot Chat Quick Start

Copilot Chat is the foundation. It's free, it's available now, and it's the fastest way to build AI fluency before in-app features unlock.

Access Points (Available Now)

  • Microsoft 365 Portal: m365.cloud.microsoft/chat
  • Edge Browser: Click Copilot icon in sidebar (or press Ctrl+Shift+.)
  • Windows: Press Win+C (Windows 11 with Copilot enabled)
  • Teams: Search for "Copilot" in apps

Phase 2: Copilot in Applications

This is where the real productivity gains unlock. Copilot embedded directly in Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, and Teams — working with your actual documents and data.

⏳ Pending Approval: In-app Copilot requires per-user licensing. We're preparing the team now so adoption is immediate when licenses are provisioned.

What Unlocks in Phase 2

Application Capability PMM Use Case
Word Draft, rewrite, summarize documents First drafts of briefs, messaging docs, case studies
PowerPoint Generate slides from prompts or documents Sales decks, exec briefings, launch presentations
Excel Analyze data, generate formulas, create charts Win/loss analysis, pricing models, market sizing
Outlook Draft emails, summarize threads, schedule Stakeholder comms, meeting prep
Teams Meeting summaries, action items, catch-up Never miss context from a meeting you couldn't attend

Phase 3: Advanced Workflows

Once the team has Copilot fluency, we move to automation and custom agents:

  • Copilot Studio: Build custom agents for repetitive PMM tasks
  • Power Automate + Copilot: Automated workflows triggered by natural language
  • Custom GPTs: Team-specific assistants trained on your content

Rollout Timeline

Week Milestone Deliverable
Week 1 Kickoff + Quick Start Team completes Quick Start Guide, first lab exercise
Week 2 Practice Sprint Complete 3 lab exercises, share one output in Teams
Week 3 Office Hours #1 Live Q&A, troubleshooting, prompt refinement
Week 4 In-App Training (if licensed) Word + PowerPoint deep dive
Week 5 Real Work Integration Each person ships one deliverable using Copilot
Week 6 Office Hours #2 + Showcase Team shares wins, establishes best practices
